name: Watercolour
summary: Transparent watercolour on cold-press paper: each part a light wash of its colour, its shadow a second glaze, the lights left as paper; a little pigment gathered at the washes' drying edges and settled in the paper's tooth, a few blooms, a faint sepia pencil line. Edge darkening and the darkest values set from five museum watercolours (CC0), measured at one scale.
